name: Choo Choo Defenders
description:
About This Game

All aboard for chaos on the tracks!

In this on-the-rails take on tower defense, build your railroad through monster-infested lands, load up your train with specialized wagons, and fight to keep the line open while delivering passengers and cargo for firepower and profit.

Strategic planning meets frantic survival

Every wave and every run gives you new choices of wagons and upgrades, unlocked through a growing deck of cards. Will you add heavy cannons, support cars, or storage to push for bigger profits? Adapt your train to the threats ahead and keep moving!

Features

  • Build your track: Plan and place railroads through the lands, shaping your route to maximize survival and efficiency

  • Assemble your train: Draw cards to add wagons, weapons, and upgrades, creating a well-oiled machine of bullets and bank

  • Fight the horde: Defend your locomotive against waves of monsters determined to stop your journey

  • Deliver and profit: Transport passengers and cargo to earn money for upgrades and expansion

  • Upgrade your engine: Strengthen your locomotive to survive longer runs and tougher enemies

  • Pixel art mayhem: Enjoy a handcrafted 2D style

Choo Choo!

Whether you prioritize defense, economy, or sheer firepower, the right combination of tracks and wagons is the difference between a successful trip and a smoking wreck.

Can you keep your train rolling through to the end of the line?
short_desc: Build your track, assemble your train and deliver cargo and carnage in equal amounts in this on-the-rails take on tower defense!
